description: Fetch MANY tasks by id in one call (batch get). Pass `ids`: an array of ids (each a corpus id, a stable 🆔/id:: value, or an unambiguous id prefix). Best-effort per item: every resolvable id returns a full task record (with content_hash for if_hash edits) in `tasks`, and any missing/ambiguous id is reported per-item in `not_found` — a bad id never fails the whole call. Response: {count, tasks:[…], not_found:[{id, reason}]}. Prefer this over N get_task calls when resolving several ids.

fields.description:
Project each returned task to only these fields (e.g.
`["id","title","due"]`) — a token-cost lever. Names are validated
against the task-record fields; an unknown name is a usage error
listing the valid set. `not_found` entries are unaffected. Omit for the
full records (default; byte-identical to before this option existed).

ids.description:
The ids to fetch. Each may be a corpus id, a stable `🆔`/`id::`
value, or an unambiguous id prefix. A missing/ambiguous id is
reported per-item in `not_found`, never failing the whole call.

name: get_tasks
